properties.description: After a synchronous reset edge, both response valids and input ready are cleared; pre-reset presentations are not mistaken for post-reset transfers.
A blocked data presentation retains valid, byte value, and last across the next edge unless reset cancels it.
A blocked status presentation retains valid and every status field independently of data-channel progress, unless reset cancels it.
Every presented data byte is justified by an already accepted input prefix or by padding of an already completed short frame, even when the output is blocked.
Justified data presentations preserve ordered input bytes, use zero padding to length four, truncate at eight, and mark exactly the expected final byte.

Every presented status corresponds in order to a completed input frame and reports its original length, clamped length, padding flag, and truncation flag; status retirement is independent of data retirement.
